solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: In earnest, praying for special pun to be concocted

definitions.note: an adjectival-looking phrase standing for the act of earnest prayer, a noun

indicators.note: something concocted is cooked up from ingredients, so these letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone earnestly prays for a special pun to be invented.
explanation.definitionFit: Suppliance is an old word for supplication, humble and earnest entreaty or prayer.

clue.text: Message in bottle heading for ocean? Nothing to write home about!

parts.note: a distress call sent in a bottle is an SOS

indicators.note: the heading of a word is its opening letter, so only that is taken

explanation.surface: A message in a bottle bound for the ocean turns out to be dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Something mediocre or middling is nothing to write home about.

clue.text: Not hear aeolian harp playing — and you'll not see its player!

indicators.note: not hearing means the letters of hear are taken away from the anagram pool
playing suggests the letters perform in a new arrangement, an anagram signal

explanation.surface: An aeolian harp, played by the wind, has no visible musician, and nobody hears its player either.
explanation.walkthrough: Take HEAR out of AEOLIAN HARP ('Not hear') and rearrange the remaining OLIANAP ('playing').
explanation.definitionFit: A player piano works mechanically, so no human performer is seen at the keyboard.

clue.text: Zero financial accrual for Bond girl, say?

parts.note: zero in a tennis score is love
money accruing on savings or a loan is interest

explanation.surface: A Bond with zero interest accruing, a finance pun on a savings bond.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bond' looks like a financial bond, which suits the money words, but it is James Bond.
explanation.definitionFit: A Bond girl is the romantic interest of the hero in a James Bond film; 'say' marks her as one example.

clue.text: The Beatles, Abba and The Who were a means for comparison

definitions.text: The Beatles, Abba and The Who were
definitions.meaning: each of these bands had four members, so every one was a foursome
two things on ... with each other are exactly comparable, a legal phrase

explanation.surface: Three famous bands were once used as a yardstick for comparing pop groups.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on all fours with something means matching it closely, so the phrase is used in comparison.

clue.text: Country has article in store

indicators.note: in says the article goes inside the store's name

parts.note: C&A is a high-street clothing store, with the ampersand written out as AND
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A nation keeps one item of goods in its stores.
explanation.walkthrough: C&A is a British clothing chain; spell its ampersand as AND to get CANDA, then put A inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Canada is a North American nation.

clue.text: The situation with Status Quo, pop group with no lead…

indicators.note: the lead of a word is its opening letter, which is dropped

parts.note: Oasis was a Manchester pop band

explanation.surface: Comparing rock band Status Quo with another pop group lacking its front man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Status Quo' looks like the band, but here it is the Latin phrase for things left unchanged.
explanation.definitionFit: The status quo is the present state left unchanged, things kept exactly in their existing condition.

clue.text: Things will always go wrong with its principles

definitions.text: Things will always go wrong with its principles

parts.words: Things will always go wrong with its principles
parts.note: describes a jokey rule of life whose whole content is that bad luck is inevitable

explanation.definitionFit: This mock law states that whatever can go wrong will, which is its single principle.

clue.text: With no means to draw very thin line for Spooner?

indicators.note: Spooner was famous for swapping the starts of words, so the opening sounds trade places

parts.note: someone very thin is bony
a stroke is a line drawn with a pen

explanation.surface: Someone without means to draw has to make do with a very thin line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'draw' here means drawing money from a bank, which a penniless person cannot do, not drawing with a pencil.
explanation.definitionFit: Being completely penniless means having no money in the bank to withdraw.

clue.text: …tailor Ravel composition to be covered by front-man for 22

indicators.note: covered means held inside the other piece

parts.note: 22 is The Police, whose singer was Sting

indicators.note: a composition puts parts together in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tailor is asked to arrange Ravel for the lead singer of a band.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composition' reads as a piece by the composer, but it is the anagram signal; 'tailor' looks like a verb but names a Shakespeare character.
explanation.definitionFit: Robin Starveling is the tailor among the mechanicals in Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream.

clue.text: I'm surprised this was the essence of the guarantee!

indicators.note: the essence is the core, so the outer letters are dropped

parts.note: a godparent stands surety, so a godchild is the one guaranteed, a guarantee in the old sense

explanation.surface: Someone surprised at what a guarantee really amounted to.
explanation.walkthrough: Chambers allows 'guarantee' for the person guaranteed; a godparent is a guarantor for a godchild.
explanation.definitionFit: Odso is an archaic exclamation of surprise, like 'gadzooks'.

clue.text: Turn off telly to knit surprise jumper

definitions.meaning: to jack in is to give up, and the box is the television
a toy figure that springs out of a box when the lid opens

explanation.surface: Someone switches off the television to knit a jumper as a surprise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jumper' suggests knitwear, but it is a thing that jumps.
explanation.definitionFit: The toy is a spring-loaded clown that leaps out to startle a child.

clue.text: Desert to adjust sexuality?

definitions.meaning: a great arid region of Mongolia and China
to ... is to become bisexual, read as two words

explanation.surface: Abandoning someone in order to change one's sexuality.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Desert' looks like a verb, to abandon, but it is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gobi is a large desert in Central Asia.

clue.text: Here see organisation's foremost British criminal ideally put away

definitions.text: Here see organisation's foremost British criminal ideally put away

indicators.note: the foremost part of a word is its first letter
criminal suggests something bent or wrong, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: At this place you see the leading British criminal of an organisation locked up, as justice would wish.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram is of O, B and IDEALLY; the whole clue describes the court where criminals are sentenced.
explanation.definitionFit: The Central Criminal Court in London, where major criminals are tried and sent to prison.

clue.text: Bars confirming identity

definitions.meaning: the symbol is two short parallel horizontal lines
the symbol states that both sides are identical in value

explanation.surface: Pubs that check customers' ID.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bars' and 'identity' suggest pubs checking ID; the clue is about a mathematical symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: The mathematical symbol of two parallel lines asserts that its two sides are identical in value.

clue.text: Where soldiers rest, each one on 4?

definitions.meaning: one over four is a fourth part, and 4-down's limbs are also so called

explanation.surface: Asking where soldiers rest, with each one sleeping on all fours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one on 4' is a fraction, one over four; the four limbs of 4-down are also called this.
explanation.definitionFit: Lodgings for troops are their billets; a fourth part of something is this fraction.

clue.text: Pin's not so straight

definitions.meaning: a long pin for holding meat while cooking
more askew, the comparative of an adjective meaning crooked

explanation.surface: A pin that is a bit bent.
explanation.definitionFit: A kebab spit is a long pin; and something more skew is less straight.

clue.text: No smile brighter than this blinder!

definitions.meaning: a beam is a broad smile, and a full one is the widest
headlights on their highest setting dazzle oncoming drivers

explanation.surface: Praising a dazzling smile as a brilliant performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blinder' reads as slang for a brilliant performance, but it is something that dazzles.
explanation.definitionFit: Headlights on their undipped setting dazzle other drivers, and a beam is also a broad grin.

clue.text: Busy couple boarding rescue vessel

indicators.note: boarding means getting on board, so one piece goes inside the vessel

parts.note: Noah's ark rescued the animals from the flood
a couple is two

explanation.surface: A pair of people busily getting on a lifeboat.
explanation.walkthrough: Noah's animals boarded two by two, which suits the couple.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone occupied in their job is busy working.

clue.text: Bright spark with his 'sounds-like' joke

indicators.note: says the following word is written as it is pronounced

parts.note: the word his is spoken with a z sound at its end
to kid is to joke or tease

explanation.surface: A clever person makes a joke that only sounds like one.
explanation.definitionFit: A bright spark is a clever, lively person, as is a young prodigy.

clue.text: Go from B to A? After doing uey, taxi loads shabby trunk

indicators.note: loads means one piece is packed inside the other
shabby means worn out and in poor shape, so the letters are reworked
a uey is a U-turn, so the word is turned around

parts.note: a cab is a taxi

explanation.surface: A taxi does a U-turn and loads a battered trunk into its boot.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'uey' is slang for a U-turn; here the taxi goes inside the reworked trunk, not the other way round.
explanation.definitionFit: Going from B back to A is retracing one's route, returning the way one came.

clue.text: I can't remember being this

parts.note: a person who cannot remember anything, including being in that state

explanation.definitionFit: Someone with memory loss cannot recall things, even their own forgetfulness.

clue.text: They keep order of Valpolicella

indicators.note: of says the letters come out of the wine's name, sitting inside it

explanation.surface: Wine waiters keeping an order of Valpolicella.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' looks like a drinks order but is law and order.
explanation.definitionFit: The force of officers whose job is maintaining public order.

clue.text: Sponge wash all over poor Ross

indicators.note: all over means surrounding the other piece

parts.note: to swill is to rinse or wash

indicators.note: poor means in bad shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone washing a sponge all over poor Ross.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sponge' looks like the bath item being used to wash, but it is a cake.
explanation.definitionFit: A jam-filled rolled sponge cake.

clue.text: Whetstone — original location for castle

definitions.meaning: a stone used for sharpening blades
in chess a castle (rook) starts the game on square h1

explanation.surface: Whetstone, a London district, was an original site for a castle.
explanation.walkthrough: Castle is the rook in chess; one rook begins on h1, read as H ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharpening stone; the word is also the verb to sharpen.

clue.text: Party to organise? At first pub welcomes it

indicators.note: welcomes means takes in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: an inn is a pub

indicators.note: at first means only the opening letter is taken

explanation.surface: Organising a party, starting with a pub that welcomes it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Party' looks like a celebration, but 'party to' means sharing in a secret.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in on a plan means sharing knowledge of it, being a participant.

clue.text: Top of finger chipped off — black!

indicators.note: the top of a word is its first letter
chipped off means broken away and removed

parts.note: a pinky is the little finger

explanation.surface: A fingertip is chipped off and goes black.
explanation.definitionFit: Something the colour of ink is very dark, as dark as black.

clue.text: Scripture's word of action when in affluent area?

parts.note: RI is religious instruction, scripture lessons in school
a verb is a doing word
as can mean when

explanation.surface: A question about scripture: the word for action in a wealthy area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affluent' reads as wealthy, but it also means a tributary stream flowing into a larger one.
explanation.definitionFit: An affluent is a tributary; the land drained by a river and its tributaries is its catchment.

clue.text: Meeting place held back by loved ones

indicators.note: held back says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A meeting place where loved ones are kept back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held' also signals the hiding: EDON sits in 'loved ones' and 'back' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: A junction point where lines or branches meet.

clue.text: This compiler with makeover is able to supplement the team 'statesman'

parts.note: after a makeover someone is new
the setter refers to themself as me
a cricket or football team is an XI, eleven players
can means is able

explanation.surface: The setter after a makeover can join the team as a statesman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'statesman' is in quotes because it means a man from a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of a southwestern US state, here a punning 'man of the state'.
